description: This file declares the interface for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory class, which provides factory methods to create and access singleton instances related to media keys capabilities for IPC in the Rialto client component.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class for obtaining singleton instances of IMediaKeysCapabilities for IPC in the Rialto client.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysCapabilities instance for IPC.
